$comment: DRAFT SOURCE DATA — NOT APPROVED. Import through the policy admin UI; status must be moved draft→review→approved by AICTE's policy owner with an independent approver (D-01). Source: AICTE Approval Process Handbook 2024-2027, Clause 1.12 / Table 1.4 as recorded in docs/spec/SPEC_v3.md §2.1 [R1]. Accuracy guardrail: these are table values, not a rule to charge every institution. Programme applicability, exemptions, conversions, historical deposits, later amendments and the correct policy version must be validated per case before any amount decision.
notes: Amount is double in the case of private leased building/land (per cited handbook text) — modelled as a land_building_factor condition requiring policy-owner confirmation.

Handbook text states the amount remains with the Council for 10 years; principal returned at end of term subject to possible extension and/or forfeiture in specified circumstances. Do not auto-apply forfeiture; see penalties.blocked.json.
Table 1.4 does not list every programme category. Unlisted programmes => 'rule not defined — cannot assess'.
